name: Fujiwara no Asatada
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 44); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 961.

poems.title: To fall in love with womankind
poems.author: Fujiwara no Asatada
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 44
poems.text:
To fall in love with womankind
Is my unlucky fate;
If only it were otherwise,
I might appreciate
Some men, whom now I hate.
